Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Mochi. Mochi loved to nap in the warm sun.
Every morning, Mochi would stretch and yawn before going outside to play.
One day, Mochi found a tiny mouse hiding in the garden.
"Hello," said Mochi softly. "Do not be afraid. I just want to be friends."
The little mouse looked up at Mochi with bright eyes.
"Really?" the mouse asked. "Friends?"
"Yes, friends," said Mochi. "We can play together."
From that day on, Mochi and the mouse were the very best of friends.<|endoftext|>
A second story begins here. The wind blew gently across the open field.
A small bird sang a happy song from a tall, green tree.
Below the tree, two children laughed and chased a red kite.
The kite danced in the wind, high above their heads.
When the sun began to set, the children waved goodbye to the bird.
"See you tomorrow!" they called as they ran home for supper.<|endoftext|>
